final: WITH manager_awards AS (SELECT ma.player_id, p.death_country, COUNT(*) as award_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), country_totals AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(award_count) as total_awards FROM manager_awards GROUP BY death_country) SELECT ma.player_id, ma.death_country, ma.award_count, CAST(ma.award_count AS FLOAT) / ct.total_awards as share FROM manager_awards ma JOIN country_totals ct ON ma.death_country = ct.death_country ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10
